name: dev-flow
description: Plan-first development for agent sessions — investigation series, reviewed plans, verified implementation, a sub-agent dev cycle that carries one change from plan to merge (with eleven role agents, each pinned to one model at one effort: scribe, scout, implementer, implementer-critical, implementer-deep, planner, planner-deep, reviewer, reviewer-light, cross-checker, cross-checker-deep), multi-agent research fan-outs, a research skill family for sourced, verified findings and a curated knowledge base (with the research-lane, research-lane-deep and research-verifier agents, routed by the research skill's own profiles), chain-of-verification fact-checking, a foundation session that lays a new project's requirements, architecture and phased plan behind review gates, and a standing librarian that takes custody of a repo's work: files, dispatches, reviews and lands (soft dependencies: work-items, without which librarian-mode stops at start with the install command and dev-cycle keeps its record in the session scratchpad, on which research, deep-investigation and chain-of-verification runs record their dispatches and a foundation run its holds and features, and whose items investigate and implement show, claim and close, saying an item was not updated when wi is not installed; statusline-hub (installing statusline brings it), whose sensor record gives rate-limit reset times, the quota sense's usage (which dev-cycle's guard on a round past the fourth review reads too) and the research skills' quota; claude-analytics (external), whose sampler sink ${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR}/claude-analytics/samples/ the quota sense reads as usage history; context-guard, for checkpoint (investigate's checkpoint-then-implement path, the research skills' checkpoint before synthesis), the context gate's advisories and rehydration, without which librarian-mode says so in each conversation's first summary (no checkpoint, no gate) and keeps the store's handoffs current at each idle turn and landing, and its usage-report, which reads the item spend dev-cycle holds each phase's budget to, the fourth review being the cap without it; kit-dev, whose update-kit takes retrospective findings and whose create-skill dev-cycle's briefs point skill builders and reviewers at; create-repo, which investigate and foundation point to when the target repo does not exist yet; sandbox, whose skill investigate and deep-investigation point to for container mounts and sidecar commits, and investigate and implement for worktree details; operator-interaction, whose decisions skill librarian-mode, dev-cycle, foundation and the research skills follow to put decisions to the operator, whose plain-names skill librarian-mode's and dev-cycle's Reports follow, whose decision-page skill's shown and seen times librarian-mode records, whose decisions skill's card-record reference librarian-mode writes each card record to, and whose decision-page skill's checker it runs on each record before storing it, when node is present, when it is installed; without the checker the record is stored after wi's own checks and the Report says so; ownership, whose claim-md skill foundation writes or proposes its scope through, and against whose claim's boundaries and interfaces its architecture gate checks the contracts, when it is installed, without which the claim is proposed in the series, unchecked, and the result says so).
